<thought>Search the retrosynthetic template catalog for templates that break an S‑Cl bond and form an N‑S bond (sulfonamide formation). This matches the forward reaction description. We'll query with functional_groups_broken = ["sulfonyl_chloride"] (if such name exists) and functional_groups_formed = ["sulfonamide"], and also specify bonds_broken = ["S-Cl"] and bonds_formed = ["N-S"]. We'll then examine the returned templates and pick one that matches the target molecule.</thought>
<action>search_template_catalog_by_criteria</action>
<action_input>{
    "molecule_smiles": "O=S(NC1=CC(N2CCN(C(OC(C)(C)C)=O)CC2)=C3C(CCC4(CCC4)O3)=C1)(C5=C(F)C=CC=C5)=O",
    "functional_groups_broken": ["sulfonyl_chloride"],
    "functional_groups_formed": ["sulfonamide"],
    "bonds_broken": ["S-Cl"],

    "limit": 5
